reason: CP1 describes the review process and triggers, while CP2 details the 25 criteria used to identify detrimental rules and practices. The review process (CP1) sets the stage for understanding the criteria (CP2).

CP2 explains the 25 criteria, and CP3 states that based on these criteria, FATF identifies noncooperative jurisdictions in grey and black lists. The criteria (CP2) are the foundation for the listing (CP3).
